compare: the JSON of child-usage.mjs --lanes-sweep (and of run mode) from the base kernel and from the U2 kernel over the same root, window and flags
rule: every key path of the base output keeps its value unless a changed entry names it; key paths an added entry names are new; any other difference is a failure (review-u2, medium finding on the differential: an explicit allow-list, equality everywhere else)

objects.actor: a per-actor measurement: sweep actors[].measurement; run-mode children[].lanes.measurement and superseded_attempts[].lanes.measurement
objects.aggregate: an aggregateMeasurements result: every sweep group (groups.all, groups.workers, groups.negative_controls, groups.by_spawn.*, groups.by_agent_type.*, groups.by_spawn_and_agent_type.*.*, groups.by_session.*) .measurement, and main.measurement
objects.sizes: every sizes object inside a measurement: m3, m5, by_carrier.<carrier>, exceptions.<class>

stages.stage: U2 stage 1: PR-A items 1, 5 and 4, binding decision B9 and U2 correction 1

added.why: item 5; the unit of the historical 'Loaded, never called' row

changed.change: decreases by hook_context.hook_names_folded (the entry disappears when it reaches 0); each folded name appears as a new by_hook key <Event>:mcp__<server>
changed.why: item 1: an over-long MCP hook name is no longer lost under '(other)'; on this host no hook name exceeds 80 characters (scans/hook-rows.json), so the expected difference here is 0

changed.change: true becomes false where usage.iteration_issues names a reason (an unread entry, an inconsistent message, an advisor result without usage, an advisor call without a result) or an advisor entry lacks a model
changed.why: binding decision B9; on this host 143 of 4,667 transcripts with messages (scans/kernel-usage.json)

unchanged_by_design: the results, bytes, large_results, large_bytes and max_bytes of every sizes object
run-mode children[].usage, usage_by_model, complete and issues; by_resolved_model; the exit code
